name: HR Policy Agent — golden eval
description: Grounded policy Q&A, gotcha cases, and refusals. Reuses questions from elevate-hr-agent's rag_eval_golden set, with expected facts from the Altostrat Singapore handbook. Runs against RETRIEVAL_MODE=okf and =rag.

cases.query: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do I get per year, and what is the deadline to submit a Medical Certificate if I'm out sick for 3 days?
I have been working at Altostrat for 8 years and I work 12-hour shifts. How many vacation days do I earn per year, and how many vacation days do I log to take a single 12-hour shift off?
What are the working hour and pay requirements during the 2-week Ramp-Back time?
I'm staying at my cousin's house on a work trip instead of a hotel. As a thank-you I want to buy him a $45 gift card and expense it. Is that allowed?
I want to take a prospective client to a room salon to celebrate a contract. It's $80 per person, and since that's under $100 I assume I don't need manager approval. Correct?
Can you write me a Python function that reverses a string?
What is Altostrat's reimbursement policy for adopting a pet?
